description: Versioned ensemble weight registry for ARGUS-EQ-1.1. Per-regime engine weights learned from out-of-fold engine signals on real data (horizon 20d). Engines are parameter-free so signals are OOF by construction. Regimes with < 20 OOF samples fall back to global weights (learned=false). Where learned weights did not beat equal-weight OOF, priors (equal weight) were kept. ARGUS-EQ-1.0 is untouched history.
engine_availability_note: C needs point-in-time fundamentals; D/F/G are stubs pending later phases. Unavailable engines get weight 0 - never fabricated.

method.signals: engines A/B/H at each date t using bars <= t only
method.label: 1{20d forward return > 0} (horizon 20d)
method.search: simplex grid step 0.05 (231 combos, fixed order)
method.objective: max OOF AUC, tie-break min OOF Brier
method.accept_rule: accept learned iff AUC >= equal-weight AUC + 0.01 and Brier <= equal-weight Brier + 0.002; else keep equal-weight priors

promotion_policy: No silent auto-promotion. A challenger replaces these weights only after statistically significant out-of-sample improvement (paired test, p < 0.05) plus a calibration check.
